dataset: offline scikit-learn 8x8 digits; all classes in both tasks
evaluation: All methods share PRETRAINED Task A weights, train/test splits and Task B minibatch orders per seed/domain. Task A importance computed only from train samples; no data replay.
interpretation: Quadratic anchoring applied after each SGD update in B. Activity pathway masks, minibatch squared-gradient proxy (NOT empirical Fisher), and shuffled-activity control.
statistics: paired seed-level descriptive bootstrap, unadjusted across many treatments/domains/metrics
limitations: Not a broad continual learning benchmark or a mechanistic proof
Only 8x8 digit transformations; 5 exploratory evaluation seeds
No rehearsal, calibrated EWC, or capacity-matched random data replay
Post-SGD regularization approximation, not an exactly integrated loss
Multiple comparisons unadjusted and tuning must use new seeds
